about: Planted truth for the case study The witness who was never there, by acceptance/cases/never-there/make.py. All content is fictional.

story.title: The witness who was never there
story.puzzle: Hollin Joinery on Tanner's Row in Larkhaven burned on the night of 14 March 2026, and forty-one people gave statements. The bookkeeper's alibi is one of the plainest: she was at her sister's house in Brindle Cross, 34 km away, from six until past midnight, and her sister agrees she came.
story.twist: The photograph she handed over to show an earlier break-in was taken at the workshop gate at 21:52 that night, and the voice note she sent her sister at 22:07 says she is still at the yard. The contradiction hunter puts her two places on one day side by side; a person reads the times and decides.

mara.title: Statement of Mara Quill: with her sister in Brindle Cross from 18:00 to past midnight on 14 March
mara.text:
Statement of Mara Quill, bookkeeper at Hollin Joinery, taken on 16 March 2026.

My name is Mara Quill. I was born in 1981. I keep the books for Hollin Joinery. On Friday 13 March 2026, early in the morning, I found the back gate on Tanner's Row forced and took a photograph of it on my phone, which I have handed over. On Saturday 14 March 2026 I drove to my sister Jo's house in Brindle Cross. I was there from about six in the evening until well past midnight and stayed the night. I heard about the fire on Sunday morning.

jo.title: Statement of Jo Quill, sister of Mara Quill
jo.text:
Statement of Jo Quill, taken on 17 March 2026.

My name is Jo Quill. I was born in 1978. On Saturday 14 March 2026 I was at home in Brindle Cross all evening. My sister Mara Quill came to dinner at my house in Brindle Cross that night. She got here late, about half past eleven; she said the traffic was bad. She stayed the night.

mq3.title: Exhibit MQ/3: photograph from Mara Quill's phone, taken 14 March 2026 at 21:52
mq3.text:
Exhibit MQ/3. Photograph IMG_4471.jpg, handed over by Mara Quill on 16 March 2026 from her phone. She said she took it early on 13 March.

Embedded metadata: taken 14 March 2026 at 21:52:07 (UTC-2); GPS position with a stated error of 8 metres at the back gate of Hollin Joinery. The metadata places the phone, and so Mara Quill, on Tanner's Row, Larkhaven on 14 March 2026. The picture shows the back gate at night, lit by the phone's flash.

mq4.title: Exhibit MQ/4: voice note from Mara Quill's phone, sent 14 March 2026 at 22:07
mq4.text:
Exhibit MQ/4. Voice note sent from Mara Quill's phone to Jo Quill on 14 March 2026 at 22:07 (UTC-2), 11 seconds, recovered from the message history.

Transcript: "Jo, it's me. Start without me, I'm still at the yard on Tanner's Row. Something's come up with the books. I'll be with you by half eleven."

On 14 March 2026 Mara Quill was at the yard on Tanner's Row when she sent it.
